repos.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新
repos.summary_zh: 本项目开源，专注为优秀Chrome插件编写中文说明书，利用docsify构建文档站点并托管于GitHub Pages。内容涵盖广告屏蔽、视频下载、翻译等实用插件，旨在降低使用门槛，让插件真正造福用户，提升浏览体验。
repos.summary_en: This open-source project provides Chinese manuals for outstanding Chrome extensions. It leverages docsify to build a documentation site hosted on GitHub Pages, covering extensions for ad blocking, video downloading, translation, and more, aiming to empower users and enhance browsing efficiency.

repos.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis
repos.summary_zh: OpenList是AList的社区分支，通过长期治理应对信任危机，保障开源健康。集成多云存储，支持阿里云盘、OneDrive、GoogleDrive等，及本地存储与FTP。基于AGPL-3.0许可，强调透明共治。提供统一的多云文件管理平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList, aiming to ensure open-source integrity through long-term governance. It integrates multiple cloud storages like Aliyundrive, OneDrive, GoogleDrive, and supports local and FTP. Licensed under AGPL-3.0, it values transparency and community governance. The project provides a unified multi-cloud file management platform for individuals and businesses.

repos.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv
repos.summary_zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件并发搜索。采用工作池设计，实现多源并发与智能排序，自动分类网盘类型。内置异步插件系统与二级缓存，提升搜索效率。Docker一键部署，开箱即用，适用于学习研究。
repos.summary_en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage resource search API service that supports concurrent searches across Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features a worker pool design for multi-source concurrency, intelligent sorting, and automatic categorization of cloud drive types. With an asynchronous plugin system and two-level caching, it significantly improves search efficiency. Docker deployment enables one-click setup, ideal for research and learning.

repos.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.
repos.summary_zh: FileCentipede是一款跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP、FTP、SSH、BT及WebDAV，并集成浏览器插件，可智能提取网页音视频，实现一站式高效上传、下载与文件管理。
repos.summary_en: FileCentipede is a powerful, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, SSH, WebDAV, and BitTorrent. With browser integration, it intelligently extracts online audio and video, providing a one-stop solution for high-speed uploads, downloads, and comprehensive file management.

repos.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目定时自动合并、去重并清洗多源广告过滤规则，通过DNS解析剔除失效域名，生成适用于AdGuard、dnsmasq等平台的轻量/完整版拦截列表，提升广告拦截效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: This project automatically merges and cleans multi-source ad-blocking rules on a regular basis, filtering out dead domains via DNS resolution. It generates optimized blocklists for platforms like AdGuard and dnsmasq, ensuring efficient and accurate ad-blocking.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供全球免费代理IP列表，包含HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，每5分钟更新一次。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式下载，并提供NPM模块和API接口，适用于爬虫、匿名访问和网络测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Provides a highly reliable, frequently updated list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies from over 140 countries. Updated every 5 minutes, it offers data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module and rotating proxy API for seamless integration into scraping and automation workflows.

repos.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。
repos.summary_zh: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV的增强版影视聚合播放器，无缝集成外部播放器、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统及AI智能问片，支持PWA与多端同步，为用户打造极致的私人定制观影体验。
repos.summary_en: MoonTVPlus is an enhanced video aggregation player featuring external player support, WebGPU super-resolution, danmaku, and AI search, delivering a seamless cross-platform viewing experience.

repos.summary_zh: 个人私有视频站，支持多网盘接入与低带宽302播放。集成短视频沉浸模式、自定义爬虫、Telegram机器人及一次性分享，助力个人轻松构建高效、私密的专属多媒体播放与管理平台。
repos.summary_en: This is a powerful personal private video website featuring multi-cloud drive integration and low-bandwidth 302 redirect playback. It integrates a TikTok-style short video swipe mode, custom spider scripts, Telegram bot connectivity, and one-time share links, helping individuals easily build a highly efficient and private media library.

repos.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个基于 React Native 的跨平台音乐播放器，聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等多平台音乐资源，支持自定义音源插件、主题美化、本地音乐管理及 WebDAV 同步，具备小爱音箱推送等智能联动功能，适用于个人多平台音乐播放与管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a cross-platform music player based on React Native, aggregating music from multiple platforms like NetEase, QQ, and Kugou. It supports custom audio source plugins, theme customization, local music management, WebDAV sync, and Xiao Ai speaker integration for smart home use, ideal for personal multi-platform music playback and management.

repos.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）
repos.summary_zh: 星海音乐源是一款针对LX Music的自定义音源插件，聚合了GDAPI等多平台接口以获取高品质音乐；其核心亮点在于支持通过自建服务器实时解密酷我加密音频，大幅扩展了桌面应用的音乐资源覆盖与播放体验。
repos.summary_en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom music source plugin for LX Music, aggregating APIs from multiple platforms to provide high-quality audio formats. Its key highlight is supporting self-deployed decryption servers to real-time decrypt and play Kuwo's encrypted audio, significantly expanding the music resource coverage and playback experience for desktop applications.

repos.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.
repos.summary_zh: CF Manager 是 Cloudflare 多账号统一管理平台，支持 Workers、DNS、存储及 AI 推理的可视化操作。面向多账号开发者与运维人员，解决账号切换与批量操作痛点。技术亮点包括内置 OpenAI 兼容接口与自托管部署，实现本地调试与数据自主控制。
repos.summary_en: CF Manager is an all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare, enabling visual management of Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference, and browser rendering. It is designed for developers and operators with multiple Cloudflare accounts, solving the pain of account switching and batch operations. Key features include an OpenAI-compatible API for local debugging and self-hosted deployment for full data control.
